correctness.rationale: For X_n=Ind_2(L(K_n)), n=5,6,7, each face is an edge set in K_n such that every chosen edge intersects at most one other. Independently enumerated all 2^10, 2^15, 2^21 candidate bitmasks and obtained f-vectors (10,45,30), (15,105,195,90), (21,210,735,945). Reconstructed complete element-matching directed Hasse graphs with 39/185/747 pairs and 180/1155/6405 incidences; all acyclic. Exact signed integral Morse boundary vanishes for X5 and X6; X7 has eight critical 2-cells and 408 critical 3-cells, with an independently recomputed full 8x408 signed matrix and displayed 8x8 determinant -1. Hurewicz in degree two identifies attachments and the unimodular minor permits cancellation, proving wedges 6S1, 24S2+10S3, and 400S3 respectively. No extrapolation beyond n=7.
